checks: Exact target/previous generation and bound initial/adoption records required under the existing Backend flock.
Closed prior failure result and witnessed previous-generation-restored boundary bind this incident; retention directory is not misrepresented as proof of completed restoration.
Original HELD checkpoint document is preserved privately before terminal RETURNED is published; a RETURNED retry requires that saved evidence.
No transition to RETURNING, no snapshot read/extraction/restore, no generation activation, SQL or application adoption.
NFT and all masks remain closed while terminal checkpoint is published; existing guard then honors selective masks.
Only fixed previously active core services are started; exact prerequisites may be unmasked without direct bootstrap invocation.
Eight old HTTP observations must match the original record before previous boot selection and durable opening marker.
Ingress opens before selected timers; ACME timer/service mapping is explicit and helper starts timers rather than their oneshot services directly.
Timer-specific SystemControl.Refused failures cannot close the reopened public applications; backend budget and other exceptions are not swallowed by that handler.
No transaction reset or removal of historical snapshot/quarantine; ViSe stays held.
corrections_verified: Catch only SystemControl.Refused for per-timer failures.
limits: This review does not itself execute the helper or prove live service availability.
Normal unit dependency activation and timer schedules can execute their declared old services after unmasking; no direct arbitrary command or oneshot action is introduced.
A future attempt still requires separate evidence-preserving archive under the same lock and a fresh full preflight/snapshot.
scope: Independent source and fixed-boundary review; author synthetic sequence tests are recorded separately.
